author: agent:claude-code
message: Bootstrap scripts per archetype, CI, root flake to 26.05, 26.05 deprecation warnings cleared, README rewritten (user's request: fix the problems found and add idempotent bootstrap scripts decoupled from just) (proposal 01a15faf-489c-72f5-8954-6975344631e7, proposed by agent:claude-code, accepted by user)

name: Bootstrap
intent: Bring a machine up to its configuration after a fresh clone with one idempotent command: ./bootstrap.sh picks the archetype (NixOS, NixOS-WSL, nix-darwin) and runs its ordered steps in nix/scripts/bootstrap/, each checking before it changes anything, with opt-ins for Homebrew and the tailnet login.

text: First-time setup is plain shell scripts, one per archetype, not just recipes
why: The user asked to decouple it from just: just needs .env, which the bootstrap writes, and a fresh install has neither just nor flakes. The scripts turn flakes on through NIX_CONFIG for their own process, read the host's nixType and username from the flake's exported configurations table (no system evaluation, so no hardware config needed yet), and run fixed steps: host, checkout, env, hardware (nixos), homebrew (darwin, --with-homebrew), system, tailscale (nixos, --with-tailscale). `just init` was removed so first-time setup has one owner.

text: Every bootstrap step is idempotent and --dry-run changes nothing
why: Each step checks before acting: .env is rewritten only when it differs (old kept as .env.bak); a hardware config already in the repo that differs from the machine's is kept unless --regen-hardware; the system is applied only when /run/current-system isn't the built one, with boot instead of switch when the kernel changes (NixOS) or the default user changes (NixOS-WSL fresh distro). Verified: nix/scripts/tests/bootstrap.test.sh (25 checks, stand-in nix and sudo in a throwaway repo) and --dry-run against the real flake for vgwsl2, vgkraken, vgsquid-jade (no hardware config yet) and vgmacbook.

text: CI evaluates every host, builds the shared home layer, and checks the scripts; still not `nix flake check`
why: `nix flake check` evaluates every nixosConfigurations entry, so it can't pass until vgnixmini and the vgsquid hosts have hardware-configuration.nix; check-hosts.sh reports those as PENDING. The GitHub workflow (.github/workflows/check.yml) runs check-hosts.sh, builds vgwsl2's home-files (1.1 GiB closure; vgkraken's is 10.7 GiB, too big for a runner) because an eval-only check once let a build failure ship, and runs shellcheck plus the bootstrap tests. Not yet run on GitHub.

text: 26.05's changed defaults are set explicitly, the same on every host
why: Hosts installed before 26.05 kept legacy defaults (and warned), hosts installed on it got the new ones. neovim's ruby and python3 providers are off everywhere (no plugin uses them); zsh's dotDir stays the home directory everywhere, so ~/.zsh_history doesn't move on the older hosts. ssh moved from matchBlocks to settings with raw ssh_config keys; the generated ~/.ssh/config is byte-identical (checked).

text: The root dev shell follows nixos-26.05 and carries shellcheck
why: The root flake (nix develop for working on the repo) was still on nixos-25.11 after every host moved; it now follows 26.05 like the rest, and has shellcheck next to just because the bootstrap scripts are checked with it in CI.
